about: Read-only extract of production D1 for 2026-11-23 (UTC), the 16 Decision Engine ledger rows since 2026-11-22 23:00 (the 15 of the UTC day and the 23:47 SELL before it), the 65 engine decisions since 2026-11-22 23:15, the feed's archived 1m bars (ledger_bars_1m, 2026-11-22 23:00 to 2026-11-23 15:19 UTC) and the last 16 15m bars of Friday 2026-11-20 aggregated from the same archive (the ATR's warm-up). Every price (entries, stops, targets, zones, key levels, bars) is the feed's minus a constant `shift` (1000): only differences of prices matter to the ledger, so no real price is kept. Agent confidences only for the five agents that traded that day. No account, ticket, login or money. The live entry council's recorded answers that day (limit_council kind entry: the signal's open id, choice, rule, time).
live_note: live = an Omega entry that filled for the decision (omega_events limit_filled by signal_issued_ms, or a done open intent with a ticket); the 14:00 BUY's limit (signal 1795442400000) rested and never filled
